title: add nvtx counters, microbench instrumentation, and perf dashboard
author: Evelyn Park
release_notes:
- Added NVTX ranges for runtime hot paths
- Exposed runtime counters via /metrics and dashboard templates
- Added microbench harnesses and a Grafana perf dashboard to track regressions
description:
Motivation: We need higher-fidelity runtime instrumentation to diagnose scheduling, kernel, and KV-cache behavior under load. This PR adds NVTX ranges and counter hooks around critical runtime stages, a set of microbench harnesses for continuous-benchmarking, and a Grafana dashboard template to visualize counters and microbench results.

What changed: - NVTX helper API and scoped ranges around: request-accept, batching-window, kernel-dispatch, kv-cache-hit/miss, kv-cache-evict, kv-cache-restore, sequence-accumulate and kv-restore paths. - Runtime counters (atomic counters and histograms) exposed through the existing metrics registry; added metric names and labels consistent with prometheus style. - Microbench harnesses under tools/microbench to exercise kv-cache, continuous batching, and kernel scheduling with reproducible configs. - A Grafana dashboard JSON and dashboard provisioning docs to visualize runtime counters, NVTX-derived traces (via perf tooling), and microbench time-series. - Unit and microbench tests and CI job to run selected microbench scenarios nightly.

Checklist: [x] NVTX ranges implemented and unit-tested; [x] counters registered and exported; [x] microbench harnesses and simple baseline jobs; [x] Grafana dashboard template and docs; [x] CI integration for tests and nightly microbench run.

Why this is safe: instrumentation is behind a runtime-config toggle (ENABLE_RUNTIME_INSTRUMENTATION) defaulting to false for production builds. Metric names are stable and documented; changes are additive only.

Related: ENG-4821 tracks the perf regression we observed in late Jan; ENG-4872 covers the perf dashboard and monitoring SLOs. SUP-2913 was used to reproduce a customer KV-cache regression that motivated additional counters.

summary: Adds NVTX instrumentation, runtime counters, microbench harnesses, and a Grafana dashboard to improve visibility into runtime scheduling, kernels, and KV-cache behavior. Instrumentation is toggleable and covered by unit and microbench tests.
